description: A FOUR-ITERATION SMOKE PROBE FOR #167, AND IT MEASURES NOTHING ABOUT THE MODEL. It answers exactly one question that reading the pinned jar could not: does SwissRailRaptor accept `useIntermodalAccessEgress = true` ALONGSIDE `useModeMappingForPassengers = true`, which this scenario depends on for the per-submode bus/rail/tram/ferry scoring (DECISIONS.md 9.78, RUN.routing.pt_submode_scoring = per_submode)? Both are now emitted together in the S2 x WEEKDAY config, and no run has ever started with them. What javap DID establish against matsim-2027.0-2026w25.jar: `DefaultRaptorStopFinder.findStops` branches on `isUseIntermodalAccessEgress()`, and the true branch resolves a real `RoutingModule` per declared parameter set mode out of the injected map - which for `walk` is the network walk router, because walk is in `routing.networkModes`. The false branch builds a beeline from `RaptorStaticConfig.getBeelineWalkDistanceFactor()`, and THAT is the leg that reaches the mobsim with a generic route and is teleported: 520,385 of them over arm 20260906T233901's 3.77 M legs, and 70.9% of 1,978 teleported walk legs on a 1% probe ending at a `pt interaction` (9.156, 9.158). What javap could NOT establish is whether the two switches coexist, and that is what this probe is for. THE OBSERVABLE IS BINARY AND STRUCTURAL: does the controler start without a config-consistency throw, and does `citysim.GenericRouteTeleporter`'s per-mode table - printed once per mobsim - show the walk-via-pt count FALL? A THIRD OUTCOME IS THE INFORMATIVE ONE: it starts, and the teleport count is unchanged, which would mean the parameter set is being ignored rather than honoured and the config route to #167 is dead whatever the jar's branches say - in which case #167 goes to the Java wrapper route that NetworkDirectWalkPtRouter already proved for the direct walk. IT IS RUN AT 1% AND FOR FOUR ITERATIONS DELIBERATELY: no mode share, patronage, count or fit statistic may be read from it, at 1% flow-capacity granularity strands car legs that 25% does not (9), and four iterations is not a reading of anything. The standing 25% directive (user, 1 September 2026) governs ARMS - runs whose readings enter the record; this is a structural smoke test whose whole output is a yes or a no, and running it at 25% would spend twenty times the machine time to learn the same bit. The gate watcher is off because a four-iteration run never reaches a milestone and a gate reading here would be meaningless anyway. All four access/egress values are DERIVED registry fields, not probe settings: the intermodal search is given exactly the reach the beeline search had (1000 m initial, 200 m extension, 1200 m ceiling = their sum), so what this probe changes is what an access leg IS and not how far the router reaches - which keeps 9.158's refutation of radius as the cause of the pt walk fallback intact. Answers #167. RESOLVED 12 September 2026 (DECISIONS.md 9.167, #167): the refusal was this project's own ride and taxi engines re-moding one leg of a five-leg trip at BeforeMobsim, not MATSim's pre-simulation pass; with the whole trip replaced, the raptor's transfer walks spliced onto the walk network and the network access basis on, 20260912T042953_4it_1pct ran 4 of 4 with genericRouteTeleporter teleported=0 on every iteration. RUN.routing.access_egress_type ships at accessEgressModeToLink and RUN.transit_router.access_egress_basis at network since that date, so this overlay now re-states the shipped values and is kept as the named re-run of the probe, read for nothing.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: A four-iteration structural smoke test is not an arm and cannot be one. The horizon sweep [250, 2000] is the range at which a RUN means something; this run is asked a yes-or-no about whether the controler starts and whether the intermodal parameter set is honoured, and four iterations is the fewest that produces a mobsim table to read the answer off. Nothing here may be read as a model result (#167).
justification.RUN.sample.fraction: The same refusal in the other direction: 1% is the cheapest fraction that still exercises the raptor over the whole schedule, and DECISIONS.md 9 forbids reading any mode share, count or fit from it - at 1% flow-capacity granularity strands car legs that 25% does not. The standing 25% directive (user, 1 September 2026) governs ARMS, whose readings enter the record; this probe has no reading, only a yes or a no (#167).
justification.RUN.gate.interval_iterations: The gate watcher is disabled because a four-iteration run never reaches a 100-iteration milestone, so the watcher would do nothing but poll a run that has already ended. This is not the GOAL.md loop being suspended - there is no gate reading here to suspend.
